## Analysis

The lone run is valid and mildly sum-dominant: 59 sums versus 55 differences at \(n=17\), yielding 1.059793. It is well below 1.144887, so the provided “SimpleTES seed” is only a starting point, not the reference construction itself. Translation, reflection, or nonzero scaling cannot change the score; improvement must come from membership changes. With 17 points in span 29, the promising search space is nearby dense subsets, including variable-size add/delete moves rather than coordinate rescaling.
